title: Scania G500 polished Aluminium FUPS compliant Bullbar #22
description: Scania G500/P450 low profile high tensile polished aluminium FUPS approved Bullbar. The large opening in the lower bar allows the AEB (Advanced Emergency Brake) and the ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) to operate without any interference from the cab protection awarded by the Bullbar. Custom extruded centre main pipe to accommodate light bar or driving lights. Combination indicator repeater/daylight running lights are recessed in the outer uprights. Total weight =100kg.
